content.text:
The site looked different because the custom font wasn't loading, and I've fixed that.

`site/css/tokens.css` pointed the `@font-face` rule at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The real folder is `site/fonts/`. The browser couldn't find the file and fell back to the system font, so text on every page changed. That also explains why all six pages looked off.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. After that, all 12 visual tests (six pages at desktop and phone size) match the approved screenshots, and all 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the typo. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
